Follow @austinkocher.com for solid data on immigration. 

Do not become numb to what they are doing.
If you want regular updates on the (catastrophic) state of immigration in the United States, follow Austin Kocher.

106 million
 
The fabricated number of people Gregory Bovino, Trump's former Border Patrol chief, says he wants to deport as illegals, about a third of the country. The real undocumented population is around 14 million.

7,750
 
Calls a St. Louis immigration hotline has fielded since January 2025, now on a public dashboard from the Ashrei Foundation. It exists because the government releases so little local enforcement data of its own.

119
 
Days Mamuka Artmeladze, a Georgian man with no criminal record and no removal order, spent in ICE detention before he died at Winn Correctional Center. He was the 19th person to die in ICE custody this year.

30
 
Pounds lost by Salah Sarsour, a Wisconsin mosque leader and green-card holder, over two months in ICE detention. His diabetes care was inconsistent, his halal meal requests denied, and staff offered him pork rinds.
